name: nn-agent-skills
description: Review lenses (adversarial, performance, risk, test coverage, dead code, AI slop, numerical, Codex), run every installed lens for the findings alone, walk the changes one at a time, or render the whole review as one HTML page, plus a concolic test generator that targets unexplored execution paths.

interface.shortDescription: Adversarial, performance, risk, test-coverage, dead-code, AI-slop, numerical, and Codex review lenses; walkthroughs and HTML reports; concolic test generation.
interface.longDescription: Ships adversarial-review, performance-code-review, risk-assessment, test-coverage-code-review, dead-code-code-review, ai-slop-code-review, numerical-code-review, and codex-code-review lenses, and runs every code-review lens installed in the environment over a branch or working-tree diff for merged findings. Walk a branch or working-tree diff one logical change at a time in the terminal, drafting GitHub comments or applying verified fixes — or render the whole review as one self-contained HTML page with an overview, a GitHub-style diff, and per-change findings. Also ships concolic-test-generation, which records each test's ordered branch decisions and writes characterization tests for paths one flipped decision away from a known path.
defaultPrompt: Review this branch and just tell me what the problems are.
Run an adversarial review of this PR.
Assess the shipping risk of this change.
Is this PR tested enough? Review test coverage.
Find dead code in this branch and propose removals.
Ruthlessly strip AI slop from this diff.
Review this branch interactively, one change at a time.
Review this branch and give me the review as a web page.
Review my local changes and fix the problems.
Generate tests for the execution paths this module's suite never takes.
